description: This file defines the interface 'JournalEntryWritePlatformService' containing method signatures related to creating, reverting, and managing accounting journal entries within the Fineract platform. It includes operations for specific transaction types such as loans, savings, shares, and external owner transfers, serving as a service contract for journal entry processing.

classes.name: JournalEntryWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface defining methods for managing journal entries related to various financial transactions within the Fineract system.

methods.name: createJournalEntry
methods.description: Creates a new journal entry based on the provided JSON command.

methods.name: revertJournalEntry
methods.description: Reverts an existing journal entry based on the provided JSON command.

methods.name: createJournalEntriesForLoan
methods.description: Creates journal entries related to a specific loan represented by the accounting bridge data.

methods.name: createJournalEntriesForSavings
methods.description: Creates journal entries for savings accounts based on provided data.

methods.name: createJournalEntriesForClientTransactions
methods.description: Creates journal entries for client transactions using provided data.

methods.name: defineOpeningBalance
methods.description: Defines an opening balance using a JSON command.

methods.name: createJournalEntryForReversedLoanTransaction
methods.description: Creates journal entries for a reversed loan transaction given date, transaction ID, and office ID.

methods.name: revertProvisioningJournalEntries
methods.description: Reverts provisioning journal entries for a given date, entity ID, and entity type.

methods.name: createProvisioningJournalEntries
methods.description: Creates provisioning journal entries based on a provisioning entry.

methods.name: createJournalEntriesForShares
methods.description: Creates journal entries related to share transactions.

methods.name: revertShareAccountJournalEntries
methods.description: Reverts share account journal entries for specified transaction IDs and date.

methods.name: createJournalEntriesForLoanTransaction
methods.description: Creates journal entries immediately for a specific loan transaction, with options for account transfer and loan-to-loan transfer.

methods.name: createJournalEntriesForExternalOwnerTransfer
methods.description: Creates journal entries for an external owner transfer involving a loan and transfer details.
